Created on **`r format(Sys.Date(), '%B %d, %Y')`** with R Markdown and Leaflet.
Click a marker for details; the circle size reflects each peak's height.

```{r map, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(leaflet)

peaks <- data.frame(
  name = c("Mount Everest", "K2", "Kangchenjunga", "Denali", "Aconcagua",
           "Mont Blanc", "Mount Kilimanjaro", "Mount Elbrus", "Mount Fuji"),
  country = c("Nepal/China", "Pakistan/China", "Nepal/India", "USA", "Argentina",
              "France/Italy", "Tanzania", "Russia", "Japan"),
  height_m = c(8849, 8611, 8586, 6190, 6961, 4806, 5895, 5642, 3776),
  lat = c(27.9881, 35.8825, 27.7025, 63.0695, -32.6532, 45.8326, -3.0674, 43.3499, 35.3606),
  lng = c(86.9250, 76.5133, 88.1475, -151.0074, -70.0109, 6.8652, 37.3556, 42.4453, 138.7274)
)

pal <- colorNumeric("YlOrRd", peaks$height_m)

leaflet(peaks) %>%
  addProviderTiles(providers$OpenTopoMap, group = "Topographic") %>%
  addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.Positron, group = "Light") %>%
  addCircleMarkers(
    lng = ~lng, lat = ~lat,
    radius = ~height_m / 600,
    color = ~pal(height_m), fillOpacity = 0.8, stroke = TRUE, weight = 1,
    label = ~name,
    popup = ~paste0("<b>", name, "</b><br>", country, "<br>", format(height_m, big.mark = ","), " m")
  ) %>%
  addLegend("bottomright", pal = pal, values = ~height_m, title = "Height (m)") %>%
  addLayersControl(baseGroups = c("Topographic", "Light"), options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE)) %>%
  addMiniMap(toggleDisplay = TRUE)
```
